mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a full moon above City Hall with a temperature of 62 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 52.

The city has launched a new rain barrel rebate program providing a 30 dollar credit for qualifying installations, and residents can also vote online through August 7 to select the new I Voted sticker designs for the upcoming November election.
We have plenty happening today including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia, with even more music and markets scheduled through the rest of the week.
During a traffic stop on July 26, an officer arrested a 55 year old Stoughton woman for an O W I after clocked her driving 97 miles per hour on US Highways 18 and 151.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Turtle, though please note that the store is currently closed and will open its doors again at 10 AM.
